{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
[[File:Gran_AA.jpg|thumb|right|240px|The Gran (member pictured) of Kinyen lived under the socialist system implemented by the ruling Tayan League.]]
'''Socialism''' was a socio-economic ideal of embracing codependence, relying on compassion, community, and cooperation amongst individuals in a society to place the collective good above individual interests. Under the socialist demarchic rule of the [[Tayan League]], the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] boasted low unemployment rates and a high gross domestic product. Poverty was nearly nonexistent, and the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] overall health and happiness was one of the highest in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

The Kinyen government held exclusive authority over contracted work in the semi-privatized [[Starship/Legends|shipping]] industry, and [[Saeduree River Shipping]] was given exclusive shipping rights for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] exports in much of the [[Capra's continent|continent]] that contained the Kinyen city of [[Capra]]. Most other sectors of business were nationalized, including food production and construction. The government had specific quotas for the amount of food needed per year, necessitating families and [[Farmer/Legends|farmhands]] of the [[Ayanee Farming Cluster]] to work together in producing [[silvergrass]].<ref name="SoR" />

==Behind the scenes==
===A number of firsts===
Socialism was first mentioned in a message to readers that was printed in [[Trade Federation Basic/Legends|Trade Federation Basic]] in the non-[[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] "[[Force Fiction]]," published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in the [[Star Wars Tales 7|seventh issue]] of the [[1999]] comic series ''[[Star Wars Tales]]''<ref name="Tales7">{{Tales|7|Force Fiction}}</ref> on [[March 7]], [[2001]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53985/star_wars_tales_1999_7|text=Star Wars Tales (1999) #7}}</ref> Featured in a restaurant menu, the message included attribution to the comic's author, [[Kevin Rubio]], the comic's artist, [[Lucas Marangon]], and the [[Wikipedia:Socialism|socialist]] [[Wikipedia:Karl Marx|Karl Marx]],<ref name="Tales7" /> who pioneered the real-world socio-economic philosophy of [[Wikipedia:Marxism|Marxism]], which addresses socialism and communism.

Socialism was first established to be an [[in-universe]] system of government in the [[2015]] sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', a supplement for the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="SoR" /> The communist [[Wikipedia:Viet Cong|Viet Cong]] and their [[Wikipedia:Vietnam War|war]] against the [[Wikipedia:United States|United States]] partly inspired [[George Lucas]]' creation of ''[[Star Wars]]'', specifically the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] who [[Battle of Endor/Legends|fought]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Making">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref>

===''Insider Interview''===
{{Dialogue|Kevin Rubio clone|Did he ask you about his crazy "hive mentality" theory, mister prime minister?|Lama Su|Well, no, he didn't&hellip;|Kevin Rubio clone|You didn't ask that?|Kevin Rubio|I sort of got sidetracked by all the clones running around&mdash;|Kevin Rubio clone|What about the Marxism vs. socialism question?|CT-282-SD00001-983725138|Actually, he thought it was communism.|Kevin Rubio clone|What an idiot&mdash;|Kevin Rubio|Hey!|attr=Kevin Rubio, his clone, Prime Minister Lama Su, and CT-282-SD00001-983725138 discuss socialism|src=<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|67|Insider Interview|''Insider'' Interview: Lama Su}}</ref>}}
[[File:Lama_Su_interview_characters.png|thumb|left|250px|Socialism was discussed in a non-canon ''Star Wars Insider'' article.]]
In the article "[[Insider Interview]]: Lama Su," written by Kevin Rubio and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider" /> on [[April 15]], [[2003]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref> Rubio interviews [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[CT-282-SD00001-983725138]], and asks of the experience of being one of many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]. The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] replies that it is comforting to know that everyone is equal in their capabilities, and when Rubio asked if it was like [[Wikipedia:Communism|communism]], the clone corrects him, stating that it would be socialism.<ref name="Insider" />

However, the clone further says that the analogy is incorrect, and asserts that it is instead [[Wikipedia:militarism|militarism]]. Later, a [[KR2|clone]] of Kevin Rubio enters alongside [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]]. The clone then asks why Rubio failed to mention his [[Wikipedia:Collective consciousness|hive mentality]] theory or the question of Marxism versus socialism, and accuses Rubio of being an idiot for not being able to distinguish socialism from communism.<ref name="Insider" />
